rv.q: "Naked Girl" is actually a bourgeois farce about nothing.
But while laughter can certainly be the best medicine, it alone isn't enough of a shot in the arm for A Naked Girl on the Appian Way .

cn.t: Richard Greenberg's comedy drowns in artificiality and tired sitcom-style one-liners, with critics finding the pseudo-provocative play toothless and exhaustingly overstuffed despite its airy Hamptons setting.

vs.sum: Completed a major renovation in early 2026 with all seats replaced and legroom expanded, making it one of Broadway's most comfortable and modern houses. New restrooms significantly reduce intermission wait times.

acc.note: Elevators to all levels. 53 assistive listening devices. 11 wheelchair seats across Orchestra and Balcony.
